entry.title: Computing with Coupled Oscillator Networks: Optimization, Memory, and Modern AI Primitives
entry.summary:
We explore how synchronization in coupled oscillator networks may be employed to perform a variety of computing tasks. These systems are becoming more attractive as an alternative to conventional digital computers due to the increasing energy demands of the latter, particularly for large-scale problems in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
